fundamental.summary: GL shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 35 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absence of congressional buying and zero news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (381.44), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and negative macro score (-4) create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 35 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Early MACD/StochRSI crossovers with OBV strength and extreme fear sentiment (14/100) create contrarian momentum setup near support at 90.64.
